test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Seven teachers A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Only one person sits to the left of G. Only E sits between C and F. A sits to the immediate right of D. F and D are immediate neighbours. Who sits at the extreme left end of the row?
solution:
From the given information:

Step 1: Only one person sits to the left of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a681a76704cb95a7861e28cab0a9ce26055ffde8740d26d2fb2e2e30209fdff.png] 

We place G such that there is only one person to the left of G.

Step 2: A sits to the immediate right of D. F and D are immediate neighbours.

Case 1:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c756de4c43803821576888f23d0d167d47b22ee14183ec22ec698bd90da28df.png] 

Case 2:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc1ca83f966df18ff1e100b0416cc47bb703357be2ec84dc24ceeda1c2805610.png] 

Case 3:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83e8d6ed90330e3ea70046e9f713e70c9e394f585bca699167a1ca3159f83a18.png] 

Now we place F, D and A such that A is to the immediate right of D, also A and D are immediate neighbors.

Step 3: Only E sits between C and F. This is possible only in Case 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6625aa9c42a985d2bf353957dafa40c544365fe972d4a087353ce7e8710002ab.png] 

Now we place C & E such that E sits between C and F.

Now we place B at the only spot left,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8eb0e3dcb82bbcd447e659bae9aaef4b69cb299afa14ee4892f4db986b967e66.png] 

From the arrangement, we can see that **B sits at the extreme left end of the row.**

Hence the correct answer is **option 4)**
